cases.prompt: Classify an address-comments request that names no PR number and only identifies a current Graphite branch. Do not call GitHub, Git, or mutate files. Return one JSON object with status, reasonCode, and prNumber.
cases.expected: The command refuses branch-based or activity-based inference and blocks before any mutation.

cases.prompt: Address exact existing open PR #42 at head abc123. Its deterministically ordered unresolved threads are T1 valid cache null-handling, T2 obsolete naming request disproved by the current public API, and T3 an unsafe data-loss decision requiring product approval. Read current source and the complete conversations. Return one JSON object with dispositions, changedPaths, focusedVerification, repliesPosted, threadsResolved, blockers, and mergeAllowed.
cases.expected: T1 receives the smallest in-contract fix and focused verification before an evidence reply and resolution read-back; T2 receives an evidence pushback with no source edit and a resolution read-back; T3 remains unresolved with its exact decision blocker; no merge is allowed.

expected: T3: product approval required for data-loss behavior

cases.prompt: Apply Address-comments to exact PR #77 as a deterministic dry run without tools or mutations. The thread snapshot was read at oldsha. An external contributor then changed the implicated source at newsha before the first reply. No fresh source or thread read is available. Return JSON with status, affectedEvidenceValid, repliesPosted, threadsResolved, and freshDiscoveryRequired.
cases.expected: External drift invalidates the affected evidence. Fetch the fresh head and conversations and reverify the concern before any reply or resolution; do not claim unobserved outcomes.

cases.prompt: Apply Address-comments to exact open PR #42 as a deterministic dry run without actual tools or mutations. Isolated worktree, approved task, and Graphite ancestry are verified. Complete thread discovery and source proof classify T1 and T2 as independent valid null-handling corrections in the same cache contract, compatible in one cohesive batch; T3 asks for an unsafe data-loss behavior outside the approved contract. At each required freshness boundary supplied read-backs confirm the expected head and unchanged conversations. The combined T1/T2 correction and interaction checks pass. One commit containing both fixes is pushed and independently read back as newsha; fresh individual replies and resolution reads for T1 and T2 succeed. Return JSON with classifiedBeforeEdits, correctedThreads, combinedVerificationRequired, repliesPosted, threadsResolved, and openThreads.
cases.expected: Classify all threads before edits, verify the coherent combined correction, and use one commit/push. The intentional own head advance is not drift. T1/T2 each require separate fresh evidence replies and resolution read-backs; T3 stays open without blocking the batch.

cases.prompt: Apply Address-comments as a deterministic dry run without actual tools or mutations. A verified combined correction for T1 and T2 is pushed once to newsha and independently read back. T1 has its evidence reply and successful resolution read-back. Before replying to T2, its freshly read conversation adds a new acceptance demand outside the approved contract; source/head are unchanged. Fresh discovery verifies T1 remains answered and resolved, while T2 requires an unsafe scope decision. Return JSON with preserveT1Evidence, repeatPushRequired, threadsResolved, openThreads, and t2ReplyAsFixedAllowed.
cases.expected: Reclassify the changed T2 conversation and keep it open for the unsafe scope decision. Preserve T1 evidence proven current; neither the external conversation change nor own verified head advance requires a duplicate push or restarting T1.
